title: Trump admin has 'done more damage' to the agency than they seem to understand: Fmr. ICE Director
text:
The House Homeland Security Committee met with ICE officials today after the two fatal shootings this month involving ICE officers. Former ICE Director Sarah Saldaña and former ICE Chief of Staff Jason Houser join Katy Tur to share their thoughts on the Trump administration’s handling of immigration.
